name: 構文複雑性分析
description: 測定します 構文の複雑さ through parse tree depth, clause density, and dependency distance を検出するために AI生成の text パターン.
useCase: 人間のような複雑さの変動を欠く単調な構文構造によるAIテキストの検出
mechanism: Parses text into constituency and dependency trees, then extracts 構文の複雑さ indices: mean parse tree depth, dependency distance, subordination ratio, T-unit length, and clause density. AI生成の text tends to produce syntactically simpler structures with less variation in complexity にわたる sentences—a 'syntactic flatness' signature that differs from the natural ebb and flow of human syntactic diversity.
source: Lu, X. (2010) - Automatic Analysis of Syntactic Complexity in Second Language Writing, International Journal of Corpus Linguistics
algorithm: Constituency Parsing + Dependency Parsing + Multi-Index Syntactic Analysis
parameters: Parser: neural constituency parser, Indices: tree depth, dependency distance, T-unit length, subordination index, clause density, Window: per-sentence
strengths:
• Captures deep grammatical structure パターン
• Multiple complementary complexity indices
• Well-grounded in linguistic theory
• Effective on academic and formal writing
limitations:
• Parser errors affect downstream metrics
• Computationally more intensive than lexical 特徴
• Some text genres are naturally syntactically simple
• Modern LLMs can produce complex syntax

references.title: Lu, X. (2010). Automatic Analysis of Syntactic Complexity in Second Language Writing. International Journal of Corpus Linguistics.
Herbold, S. et al. (2023). A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays. Scientific Reports.
Yang, X. et al. (2023). A Survey on Detection of LLMs-Generated Content. arXiv.
